title: February event: a tic-tac uses hills to hide from the sensors
summary: James Valor tells of February event: a tic-tac uses hills to hide from the sensors, about February 2025 at Skywatcher field operation (unspecified), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And, for example, during our February event we had an object of the 2nd class, which demonstrated very strange behavior, which you have never seen before didn't see. He actually used hills to hide from us and disappear from our main sensors.
But on the fifth the day the obstacles were constant throughout two hours.
tellings.difference: Adds day-five two hours of interference and a manta ray also hiding behind terrain, with Jordan credited.
tellings.link_reason: Day five interference with a class 2 tic-tac and manta ray hiding behind terrain matches the February tic-tac using hills to hide from sensors.

as_told.title: Day five: two hours of interference, then a class 2 'tic-tac' and a 'manta ray' found hiding behind terrain
as_told.place_text: Skywatcher field site, about 800 m up and 800 m away

plain: Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon UFOs, describes a field operation it held in February 2025. One of its people, James Valor, says they saw an object that the team ranks as "second class", a tic tac, meaning a white oval object shaped like the mint. According to Valor, it behaved in a way they had never seen before: it used the hills to hide from them and slipped off their main sensors. A second Skywatcher account, crediting a team member named Jordan, adds that on the fifth day the interference with their equipment was constant for two hours, and that an object shaped like a manta ray also hid behind the terrain. If true, it would mean these objects know they are being watched and can deliberately dodge the instruments tracking them.
